results.headline: Further Rare Earth Project Update
results.key_quote: While these are preliminary results, they place the Project on a genuine carbonatite system which identifies REE- and niobium–tantalum-bearing minerals. The assay results for the samples collected will tell us whether the mineralogy identified is accompanied by grade.
results.summary: Amigo Resources reports first-phase geological mapping results from its Nachendezwaya rare earth project in Tanzania, confirming a carbonatite-alkaline complex and identifying REE and Nb-Ta bearing minerals through petrography and scanning electron microscopy. The company collected 118 samples (32 rock, 86 soil) which are pending assay results. No assay results have been received yet, no grades are reported, and there is no comparison to any prior expectations or guidance. This is a preliminary exploration update with no performance metrics versus expectations stated.

results.headline: Clinical Trial Update
results.key_quote: These data sets from our optimised lipid formulation are very encouraging. We believe we have addressed the absorption limits of the original tablet: at 120mg twice daily, exposure now rises in line with dose with higher levels of active free drug, which we believe is what matters most for AO-252's biological activity.
results.summary: Coiled Therapeutics reported early clinical data from its optimised lipid formulation of AO-252 that exceeded the absorption performance of the original tablet formulation. At 120mg BID, the new formulation achieved approximately 1.6x exposure in line with the dose increase (the original tablet formulation had shown anomalously lower exposure at the same dose). Early anti-tumour activity was observed in heavily pre-treated patients, with 3 of 4 evaluable patients showing clinical benefit including tumour reductions of 21% and 14%. The company successfully addressed a known formulation limitation, achieving dose-proportional exposure and demonstrating early efficacy signals across multiple cancer types. No dose-limiting toxicities were observed. Results represent progress ahead of what the original formulation was delivering.
metrics_ahead: Pharmacokinetic exposure at 120mg BID approximately 1.6x the original tablet formulation
Dose-proportional exposure achieved (overcoming prior non-linear response)
Early anti-tumour activity with tumour reductions observed
3 of 4 evaluable patients showing clinical benefit
Higher free drug concentrations (1.6x at 160mg QD) relevant to mechanism of action

results.headline: Trading and balance sheet update
results.key_quote: Year-end net debt was approximately £64m, well within the Group's currently available facilities of £240m and better than the Group's previous guidance range of £70m to £90m.
results.summary: Net debt performance was ahead of guidance at £64m versus the previous range of £70m-£90m, reflecting disciplined working capital management. However, this is offset by significantly deteriorating operational performance: completions at the bottom end of guidance (1,353 vs 1,350-1,400 range), substantially weakened trading conditions with sales rates declining to 0.34 in Sept-Oct, and a major profit downgrade with Adjusted EBIT now expected to be a loss of £30m-£40m rather than profitability. The company is also taking additional NRV provisions of £10m-£15m and exceptional charges of £20m-£25m. FY27 is expected to continue generating losses.
metrics_ahead: Net debt position better than guidance

results.headline: Trading update and CMD with earnings upgrades

results.summary: Drax delivered significantly stronger than expected 2026 performance, with full year Adj. EBITDA now expected to be significantly above current analyst consensus. The company added approximately £50 million to its net contracted power position for 2026 through strong system support and generation performance in September and October, plus Balancing Mechanism activity. This outperformance reflects the dispatchable nature of the portfolio and trading capabilities. At the CMD, management outlined ambitious growth plans targeting double-digit average annual earnings growth (2027-2031) with Adj. EBITDA of £800-900m in 2029 and >£1bn in 2031, alongside >10% average dividend per share CAGR. Guidance has been upgraded versus prior consensus.
metrics_ahead: Full year 2026 Adj. EBITDA significantly above current analyst consensus
Added £50 million to net contracted power position for 2026
Strong system support and generation performance in September and October
BSIF acquisition performing in line with expectations

results.headline: Research Update
results.key_quote: NIDA has completed its in vitro evaluation of SVN-015, delivering encouraging safety and pharmacology results and progressing the compound towards preclinical in vivo testing.
results.summary: Solvonis announced positive in vitro safety and pharmacology results for SVN-015 from US Government-funded NIDA testing. The compound showed encouraging safety profile with no 5-HT2B receptor activation, confirmed selective dopamine and serotonin reuptake inhibitor activity, and is progressing to in vivo testing expected imminently. The announcement represents advancement of the program with independent validation and de-risking of the asset, with potential pathway to up to US$15 million in non-dilutive NIH funding. No prior explicit expectations stated, but the progression with positive results and continued milestone achievement positions the program ahead of typical preclinical development timelines.
metrics_ahead: No off-target binding at screened receptors
Program progressed to in vivo stage as expected

results.key_quote: While we did not perform as well as expected against some key financial metrics, the successful securing of our largest ever contract win was a major milestone for the business.

results.headline: 9M and 3Q financial results
results.key_quote: Profit for the period attributable to shareholders of the Bank 727,456 KZT mln for 9M 2026 vs 809,933 KZT mln for 9M 2025, a decline of 10.2% year-on-year
results.summary: Halyk Bank reported 9M 2026 results with mixed underlying metrics but overall profit decline. While interest income grew 11.2%, net interest margin compressed from 7.2% to 6.9%, and profit attributable to shareholders fell 10.2% year-on-year to 727.5 billion KZT from 809.9 billion KZT. Return on average equity declined from 33.8% to 26.8%, and return on average assets fell from 5.6% to 4.5%. Fee and commission income declined 3.2%, net insurance income collapsed 89.6%, and operating expenses rose 9.1%. The cost-to-income ratio deteriorated to 19.2% from 16.9%. No explicit guidance or forward expectations were stated in the announcement, but the year-on-year profit decline indicates underperformance against prior period and implied expectations.
